review_notes: Inspected all 85 lines of the target and the downstream half-disk uses in DiskBoundaryRegion.lean and DiskSideRegionImages.lean. The suggested membership lemmas are a focused interface improvement; I found no supported rewrite-direction or cycle issue.

findings.excerpt:
def closedUpperDisk : Set ℂ := {z | ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z.im}
def openUpperDisk : Set ℂ := {z | ‖z‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < z.im}
findings.problem: The file provides no simp-facing membership rules for these named sets. Downstream proofs consequently unfold the definitions explicitly to reason about membership, even when the intended normal form is simply the conjunction of the norm and imaginary-part conditions.
findings.proposed_change: Add simp lemmas such as `@[simp] lemma mem_closedUpperDisk {z : ℂ} : z ∈ closedUpperDisk ↔ ‖z‖ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z.im := Iff.rfl` and `@[simp] lemma mem_openUpperDisk {z : ℂ} : z ∈ openUpperDisk ↔ ‖z‖ < 1 ∧ 0 < z.im := Iff.rfl`. The strict and non-strict inequalities should remain distinct.
findings.benefit: Membership goals and hypotheses normalize to the defining conditions without manually unfolding the sets, while preserving the boundary cases. This directly addresses existing downstream proofs that currently expand these definitions.
